points.title: Validation definition
points.must: An automatic check by the computer that data is sensible / reasonable and follows the rules; cannot check data is correct.

points.title: Verification definition
points.must: A check that data was entered / copied accurately and matches the original source.

points.title: Verification methods
points.must: Double entry (typed twice, compared) and visual check / proofreading against the original document.

points.title: Validation vs verification comparison
points.must: Table: question asked, who does it, examples, and an error each one catches (150 vs 67 typed as 76).

points.title: Validation checks
points.must: Presence, type, range, length, lookup, format, uniqueness — each with a rule example.

points.title: Validation in SQL
points.must: NOT NULL, the data type, CHECK (… BETWEEN …), CHECK (… IN (…)), CHECK (LENGTH(…) = n), LIKE pattern, UNIQUE — in a CREATE TABLE.

points.title: Worked example
points.must: A scenario (e.g. olympiad registration) with each check named as validation or verification and why.

points.title: ORDER BY definition
points.must: ORDER BY sorts the rows of the result; ASC (default) or DESC; always the last clause.

points.title: ORDER BY examples
points.must: Sorting by one field ASC and DESC, and by two fields (second field decides ties); WHERE before ORDER BY.

points.title: Order of clauses
points.must: SELECT → FROM → WHERE → GROUP BY → ORDER BY.

points.title: ASC and DESC meaning
points.must: Numbers small → large, text A → Z, dates oldest first for ASC; reverse for DESC; typical task wording.

points.title: Aggregate functions
points.must: COUNT(*), SUM, AVG, MAX, MIN (and GROUP BY) with an example and its result.

points.title: Common mistakes
points.must: At least two: ORDER BY before WHERE, SORT BY, forgetting DESC, 'validation checks data is correct'.
